name: eos-dependency-engine
description: Analyzes codebase dependencies and computes impact for changes. Invoke when running impact analysis or identifying high-leverage next tasks.
author: EOS Development Team

inputs: work_id: string - Target work item identifier
change_path: string - Path of proposed modification
workspace_path: string - Root path of codebase to scan
outputs: leverage_score: float - Ranking of task leverage potential
blocker_analysis: object - Identified bottlenecks and constraints

preconditions: eos-recon has completed initial workspace scan
Workspace initialized and dependency graph available

risks: Cross-module breaking changes if impact unanalyzed
Suboptimal task selection without leverage calculation
risk_assessment.impact: Medium - can lead to avoidable integration issues
risk_assessment.mitigation: Mandatory dependency analysis before code modification

authority_boundaries: Read-only access to codebase, no file modifications
Can only write analysis reports to .eos-state/dependency/
Cannot modify locked directories: packages/eos-core/foundations/, src/eos/semantics/
